responses.text: {Slightly bored} Caravan, citizen, pilgrim, or...?
{Nods to player} Been doing a lot of good work out there, setting an example for the others - I know Ranger Jackson appreciates it.
Back again, I see. Something you need?

topics.prompt: GREETING

responses.text: More than you already have? Might want to ask around, but truth is, you've already helped out a lot in the short time you've been here.
I suppose you could talk to Ghost, up on top of the barracks - uh, Ranger Ghost. Something about trouble in Nipton, maybe.
{A little surprised by the offer} Help? Oh, well... you could speak to Ranger Jackson. He might have something for you.
He sort of runs things around here, mostly ends up sending reports back West that aren't filled with the best news.

topics.prompt: Anything I can do to help around here?

responses.text: All right then... just sign here, here, and... here.

topics.prompt: I need repairs.

responses.text: Not exactly sure... radio's been on the fritz, and since I haven't heard any shooting, I don't think it's urgent. Can't hurt to go ask her.

topics.prompt: What kind of trouble?

responses.text: NCR border guard duty mostly. It's our job to make sure the caravans can move safely along I-15 and Highway 95.
Not the best posting or assignment, but it beats being sent East, or patrolling the Colorado. Legion's pretty thick there.

topics.prompt: Can you tell me about the Outpost?

responses.text: {Surprised a bit that someone would care to ask} Me, I'm Knight - Major Knight. I've been stuck here dealing with these caravans for ages now, but somebody's gotta do it.

topics.prompt: Who are you?

responses.text: It ain't so bad. If Caesar's Legion decides to push West through Nipton ol' Mojave Outpost here will be the front line.

topics.prompt: Not exciting enough for you?

responses.text: I see the wisdom in that. I'll radio for a unit to head up to Primm and offer some additional support.

topics.prompt: I've helped out around here, sending troops to Primm will fortify the NCR in the region.

responses.text: {Slight surprise} Primm? {Recalling to himself} Hayes' unit is stationed up there, were having problems with some of the NCRCF convicts. What can I help you with?

topics.prompt: I'd like to talk to you about Primm.

responses.text: {Frowns} I'd like to help - {beat, hates this} but we can't spare any more units. {Reciting the official line, even though he hates it} We have to maintain a minimum headcount at the Outpost, orders from the West.

topics.prompt: Hayes is undermanned and is requesting some additional support.

responses.text: {Disbelief} One of the Powder Gangers? {Slight anger, they're like terrorists} They've been nothing but trouble for us - why would we want one of them anywhere in an official capacity?

topics.prompt: One of the convicts from NCRCF is looking for a pardon so he can protect Primm.

responses.text: [SUCCEEDED] I see the wisdom in that. I'll radio for a unit to head up to Primm and offer some additional support.

topics.prompt: Having Primm - and the trade route - under NCR control would help the West.
topics.label: <Barter Options>

responses.text: [FAILED] {Player just said something stupid} NCR is not in the habit of buying and selling towns... unless that was some sort of joke on your part.

topics.prompt: If the NCR runs Primm... I bet you could sell it to... someone... somewhere.
topics.label: <Barter Options>

responses.text: [SUCCEEDED] Hmm.{Pensive pause} All right. If his sentence was closing up I can see about getting him pardoned.
Primm is important to our trade up from California, so having someone there who owes us a favor... that couldn't hurt.

topics.prompt: His sentence was almost up, and he isn't tied to the Powder Gangers.
topics.label: <Speech Options>

responses.text: [FAILED] I don't think so. I'm not going to put my word on the line for some random convict.

topics.prompt: Come on, he's just a convict. How bad could he be?
topics.label: <Speech Options>

responses.text: {Slightly uncomfortable, voice down} Well, having a sheriff who was a convict is better than no sheriff at all... and if he has the qualifications... all right, hand it over.
If you {emph} had 200 caps, we could talk business - until then, we don't have anything to talk about.

topics.prompt: Do you think I could "buy" a pardon for 200 caps?

responses.text: Goodbye.

topics.prompt: Never mind, I'll be leaving now.

responses.text: Goodbye.

responses.text: {Sad} It has. It was a promising trade town - before the escape at the correctional facility. {Shakes head, recalling a bad memory} Lost a good bit of money at the Vikki and Vance.

topics.prompt: Primm has seen better days.

responses.text: Just need something for the log book, keeping tabs on traffic through the Outpost... {to himself} although mostly just in, not out these days.
If you're looking for the commanding officer, he's in the back. Although... he's got a lot on his plate, so if you speak with him... keep it short.
Also, you need any gear checked, we can get you up and running again... once you fill out the work orders, and sign for the parts, of course.

topics.prompt: What?

responses.text: {Curious} Reinforcements? {Beat, to himself} About time we got some more hands around here.

topics.prompt: [NCR] NCR Soldier.

responses.text: Oh - Knight. {Frowns, a little uncomfortable} You must not be from around here. If so... it doesn't do to get too friendly. {Knight's homosexual, but he doesn't want anyone in the Outpost to know for reasons he'll explain soon.}

topics.prompt: [Confirmed Bachelor] You didn't tell me your name.

responses.text: {Quieter, doesn't want to be overheard} This isn't the Republic. Oddly enough, Legion's a little more forgiving about... friendships. Out here, it's not as accepted.
{Slightly apologetic} Not that I mind being friends, it's just being open about it in the Outpost... well, I have to work here.

topics.prompt: What do you mean?

responses.text: Now wait a minute - Republic's a sight better than... other alternatives. Women are serving here, after all. The rest... well, might take some time.
And they're more accepting back West, like I said. In the meantime...

topics.prompt: Didn't realize NCR was so spineless.

responses.text: Wait... wait a minute. Look. Some things in the NCR are... aren't ideal. But I want to help.
{Slight conspiratorial} If you need something repaired... let me know, I can sign the work order. As long as caps change hands, I can put them back in yours.

topics.prompt: Forget it, then, you're a waste of time.

responses.text: I... would, perhaps some other time. When my orders take me to Vegas, perhaps. Wish things were different, but might take some time.

topics.prompt: So is that a "no," you don't want to be friends, or...

responses.text: {Slight conspiratorial smile} Let me sign off on the work order for you, then.

topics.prompt: I could use some help with my gear.
